name: proyecto-final
description: Sistema distribuido para un videojuego multijugador

scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:auth:a" "npm run start:auth:b" "npm run start:auth:c" "npm run start:coord:a" "npm run start:coord:b" "npm run start:coord:c" "npm run start:client"
scripts.start:auth: cd auth-service && cross-env PORT=4000 PEER_PORT=4001 AUTH_ID=auth-a PUBLIC_URL=https://breadless-keren-topfull.ngrok-free.dev PEER_URL=ws://localhost:4001 AUTH_PEERS=ws://localhost:4003,ws://localhost:4005 DB_PATH=users-a.db node index.js
scripts.start:auth:a: cd auth-service && cross-env PORT=4000 PEER_PORT=4001 AUTH_ID=auth-a PUBLIC_URL=https://breadless-keren-topfull.ngrok-free.dev PEER_URL=ws://localhost:4001 AUTH_PEERS=ws://localhost:4003,ws://localhost:4005 DB_PATH=users-a.db node index.js
scripts.start:auth:b: cd auth-service && cross-env PORT=4002 PEER_PORT=4003 AUTH_ID=auth-b PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:4002 PEER_URL=ws://localhost:4003 AUTH_PEERS=ws://localhost:4001,ws://localhost:4005 DB_PATH=users-b.db node index.js
scripts.start:auth:c: cd auth-service && cross-env PORT=4004 PEER_PORT=4005 AUTH_ID=auth-c PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:4004 PEER_URL=ws://localhost:4005 AUTH_PEERS=ws://localhost:4001,ws://localhost:4003 DB_PATH=users-c.db node index.js
scripts.start:coord:a: cd coordinator && cross-env PORT=5000 COORDINATOR_ID=coord-A PUBLIC_URL=wss://subvitalised-arie-morphemically.ngrok-free.dev PEER_URL=wss://subvitalised-arie-morphemically.ngrok-free.dev/peer AUTH_URLS=https://breadless-keren-topfull.ngrok-free.dev,http://localhost:4002,http://localhost:4004 node index.js
scripts.start:coord:b: cd coordinator && cross-env PORT=5002 COORDINATOR_ID=coord-B PUBLIC_URL=wss://PON_AQUI_URL_NGROK_COORD_B PEER_URL=wss://PON_AQUI_URL_NGROK_COORD_B/peer AUTH_URLS=https://breadless-keren-topfull.ngrok-free.dev,http://localhost:4002,http://localhost:4004 node index.js
scripts.start:coord:c: cd coordinator && cross-env PORT=5004 COORDINATOR_ID=coord-C PUBLIC_URL=ws://localhost:5004 PEER_URL=ws://localhost:5004/peer AUTH_URLS=https://breadless-keren-topfull.ngrok-free.dev,http://localhost:4002,http://localhost:4004 node index.js
scripts.setup: cd auth-service && npm install && npm rebuild better-sqlite3 && cd ../coordinator && npm install
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd auth-service && npm install && npm rebuild better-sqlite3 && cd ../coordinator && npm install
